story: Cirrus Vision – Single-engine personal jet aircraft
text: Here's a video of the company's piston-engined model landing under parachute in the middle of the Pacific ocean, taken by a Coast Guard rescue aircraft. [VIDEO]

story: Pilots who risk their lives flying tiny planes over the Atlantic
text: There was another incident like that too, a guy tried to make it to Hawaii and calculated he'd not make it because of headwinds and had to ditch. He deployed his airframe parachute in the plane and was picked up by a life boat from a cruise ship. Here is the coastguard video of the event: [VIDEO]

story: Cirrus Vision Jet Pilot Pulls Chute in Florida
text: I you watch the video of a previous CAPS landing over water, the landings can still be a bit rough: [VIDEO] But obviously 10x better than the alternative.

story: Wagner leader Yevgeny Prigozhin listed as passenger on plane which crashed
text: Perhaps some private planes (Cirrus) are better equipped to survive losing a wing, since they have rocket-deployed parachutes. Somewhat boring video of the parachute in action ("boring" being a synonym for "an amazing triumph of safety engineering"): [VIDEO] 14m video essay about the system: [LINK] (Reporting says this was an Embraer, this is strictly a tangent.)
